title: Just Juice Reborn Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Reborn Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a brilliantly sharp and intensely refreshing beverage profile. The inhale provides the zesty, bright tartness of freshly squeezed Lemon, expertly balanced with a smooth, syrupy sweetness to replicate classic Lemonade. To complete the experience, a gentle cooling effect washes over the palate on the exhale, ensuring a crisp and revitalising vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. Formulated with a specific 40VG/60PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour clarity and a slightly more pronounced throat hit. It is designed to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Just Juice Reborn collection brings back a selection of original e-liquid flavours, refined and updated to deliver a highly concentrated, bar-style experience. Offering exceptional quality and familiarity, this range provides a dependable option for everyday use. Beyond the sparkling citrus notes of Lemonade, vapers can explore other revitalised profiles such as the crisp Apple & Pear on Ice or the sweet Blue Raspberry.
